newsitem.title: USA: Leucadia may sell some insurance operations.
newsitem.headline: Leucadia may sell some insurance operations.

text.p: Leucadia National Corp said Wednesday that several companies have expressed interest in acquiring certain of its insurance operations.
The company said it is considering the sale of one or more of these operations and is in discussions with certain interested parties.
The prices being discussed for the operations are "substantially in excess of book value of these operations," Leucadia said.
Leucadia said there is no assurance about a deal being completed and for what price.
No further developments about the status of the negotiations will be announced until and agreement is reached, Leucadia said.
